name: Share the Road with Oncoming Traffic
description: This sign means you have to share the road with oncoming traffic.

name: Divided Road Ends, Keep to the Right
description: Divided road ends, keep to the right.

name: Road Ahead Turns Right, Then Left
description: The road ahead first turns right, then left.

name: Deer Regularly Cross, Be Alert for Animals
description: This is a 'Deer Crossing' road sign.

name: Bumpy or Uneven Pavement Ahead
description: This is a 'Bumpy or Uneven Pavement Ahead' road sign.

name: Merge with Traffic
description: This sign warns about merging with traffic, where traffic on two roads are equally responsible to merge correctly.

name: Median Ahead; Keep to the Right
description: This is a warning sign saying that the road ahead is separated by a median. Keep to the right of the median or barrier.

name: A School Crossing Ahead
description: This is a 'School Crossing Ahead' road sign. Follow the directions of the crossing guard or school safety patroller.

name: A Hidden School Bus Stop Ahead
description: This is a 'Hidden School Bus Stop Ahead' road sign. Slow down, drive with extra caution, watch for children and school buses with flashing red lights.

name: Right Lane Ends Ahead
description: This is a 'Right Lane Ends' sign. If you are in this lane, make sure you safely merge with traffic in the lane to the left.

name: School Zone Sign
description: This is a 'School Zone' sign.

name: Winding Road
description: This is a 'Winding Road Ahead' sign.

name: Stop Sign Ahead
description: This is a 'Stop Sign Ahead' road sign. Be prepared to stop.

name: Steep Hill Ahead
description: This is a 'Steep Hill Ahead' road sign.

name: Narrow Bridge Ahead
description: This is a 'Narrow Bridge Ahead' road sign.

name: Truck Entrance Ahead on the Right
description: This sign means there is a truck entrance ahead on the right.

name: Road Branching Off Ahead
description: This is a 'Road Branching Off Ahead' road sign.

name: Railway Crossing Ahead
description: This is a sign indicating that a railway crossing is ahead.

name: Bicycle Crossing Ahead
description: This is a 'Bicycle Crossing Ahead' road sign.

name: Danger, Sharp Turn
description: This is a 'Sharp Turn Ahead' road sign.

name: Drivers on the Sideroad of the Intersection Ahead Don't Have a Clear View of Traffic
description: This is a warning sign showing that drivers on the sideroad at the intersection ahead don't have a clear view of traffic.

name: Bus Entrance Ahead on the Right
description: This sign indicates an upcoming bus entrance on the right and vehicles should be prepared to yield to buses entering the roadway.

name: Pavement Is Slippery When Wet
description: This is a 'Slippery When Wet' road sign. Drive with caution.

name: Fire Truck Entrance Ahead on the Right
description: This sign indicates an upcoming fire truck entrance on the right and vehicles should be prepared to yield to fire trucks entering the roadway.

name: Maximum Safe Speed for the Curve
description: Posted under a curve warning, this sign shows the maximum safe speed for the curve.

name: You Are Approaching a Railroad Crossing
description: This sign warns you that there is a rail road crossing ahead.

name: Slow Traffic Must Keep Right
description: Slow traffic on multi-lane roads must keep right.

name: This Lane Is for Bicycles Only
description: This is a 'Bicycles Only' lane sign.

name: Two-Way Left Turn Lane
description: This is a 'Two-way Left Turn Lane' road markup.

name: Do Not Block Intersection
description: This is a 'Do Not Block The Intersection' road sign.

name: Keep to the Right Lane, Except When Passing on Two-Lane Sections Where Climbing or Passing Lanes Are Provided
description: This is a regulatory sign instructing drivers to keep to the right lane except when passing on two-lane sections where climbing or passing lanes are provided.

name: These Signs Tell Drivers the Direction They Must Travel
description: These signs, above the road or as markings on the pavement before an intersection, tell drivers the direction they must travel.

name: Be More Aware of Pedestrians and Your Speed in This Area
description: This sign indicates areas where the community has identified that there is a special risk to pedestrians. Traffic related offences committed within the zone are subject to increased fines.

name: Speed Limit Changes Ahead, with Maximum Speed of 50 km/h
description: This is a regulatory sign indicating that there is a speed limit change ahead. You must be prepared to slow down to the posted speed when you see another speed limit sign without an arrow.

name: School Buses Load and Unload in This Area
description: This sign marks a zone within which school buses load or unload passengers without using the red alternating lights and stop arm.

name: Keep to the Right of the Traffic Island
description: You must keep to the right of the traffic island when you see this sign.

name: Lane Usage Sign Meaning Right Turn Only
description: This is a 'Right Turn Only' road sign.

name: Traffic Must Travel in One Direction Only
description: This is a 'One Direction Only' road sign.

name: Shows Maximum Speed Limit on the Highway
description: This is a 'Maximum Speed Limit On The Highway' road sign.

name: You Must Exit If You Remain in Right-Hand Lane
description: This sign means 'Right Lane Must Exit'.

name: You Must Stop If a School Bus Has Flashing Signals
description: This sign means that you must stop for school bus when signals are flashing.

name: Do Not Drive Straight Through the Intersection
description: This is a sign also known as 'Do Not Drive Straight Through the Intersection'.

name: Red Light Camera at Intersection
description: This intersection is monitored with a red light camera.

name: Do Not Turn Left During the Times Shown
description: This sign means 'No Left Turn During The Posted Times'.

name: Do Not Stop in the Area Between the Signs
description: This sign means that stopping is not allowed in the area between the signs, even for a moment.

name: You Must Not Make a Left Turn
description: This is a 'No Left Turn' road sign.

name: No Right Turn on Red
description: This is a 'No Right Turn On Red' sign.

name: No Pedestrians Allowed
description: This is a 'No Pedestrians' road sign.

name: You Must Give the Right-of-Way
description: This is a 'Yield' sign.

name: No Bicycles Allowed on This Road
description: This is a 'No Bicycles Allowed' road sign.

name: Passing Is Not Allowed
description: This is a 'Passing is not allowed' sign.

name: Do Not Stand or Stop in This Area
description: This sign means 'No Standing or Stopping in This Area'.

name: You Must Not Make a U-Turn
description: This is a 'No U-Turn Allowed' sign.

name: No Idling for More Than 3 Min
description: This is a 'No Idling' sign.

name: Keep Out (Do Not Enter)
description: This is a 'Do Not Enter' road sign.

name: Stop and Yield the Right-of-Way to Passing Vehicles from Both Directions
description: This is a Stop sign, you must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way to passing vehicles from both directions.

name: Do Not Pass Any Vehicles Within 30 Metres of a Pedestrian Crossing
description: This is a pedestrian crossover. Be prepared to stop and yield right-of-way to pedestrians.

name: Only for Vehicles Displaying a Valid Disabled Person Parking Permit
description: This sign is placed in the areas where parking is permitted only for vehicles displaying a valid Disabled Person Parking Permit.

name: You Must Stop and Are Prohibited from Passing
description: When a school bus arm swings out with red lights flashing, you must stop and are prohibited from passing.

name: You May Park in the Designated Area During the Posted Times
description: You may park in the designated area during the posted times only.

name: This Road Is an Official Bicycle Route
description: This road is an official bicycle route. Watch for cyclists and be prepared to share the road with them.

name: Snowmobiles May Use This Road
description: This is a 'Snowmobiles May Use This Road' sign.

name: Permissive Sign
description: You may or must do the activity shown inside the ring, hence, it is a permissive sign.

name: Survey Crew Working on the Road Ahead
description: This is a 'Survey Crew Ahead' road sign.

name: Closed Lane
description: There is a closed lane ahead. Adjust speed to merge with traffic in lane indicated by arrow.

name: Traffic Control Person Ahead
description: This sign indicates a traffic control person ahead. Drive slowly and watch for instructions.

name: Pavement Has Been Milled or Grooved
description: This sign means that the pavement has been milled or grooved. Your vehicle's stopping ability may be affected so obey the speed limit and drive with extra caution. Motorcyclists may experience reduced traction on these surfaces.

name: Follow Detour Marker Until You Return to Regular Route
description: These signs warn of unusual temporary conditions such as road work zones, diversions, detours, lane closures or traffic control people on the road. This particular sign means 'Follow detour marker until you return to regular route'.

name: Road Work Operation Ahead
description: This is a 'Road Work Ahead' sign.

name: Wheelchair Only or Disabled (Handicapped) Person Parking
description: This is a 'Wheelchair Only or Disabled (Handicapped) Person Parking' sign.

name: The Upcoming Roundabout Exits and Where They Will Take You
description: This sign shows the upcoming roundabout exits and where they will take you.

name: Destination Board
description: This is a destination board with several destinations.

name: Route to Airport
description: This is a 'Route To Airport' sign.

name: Hospital
description: This is a 'Hospital' sign.

name: Railway Crossing
description: All railway crossings on public roads in Ontario are marked with large red and white 'X' signs.

name: Slow Moving Vehicle
description: This is a 'Slow Moving Vehicle' sign.

name: Two or More Passengers Must Be in the Vehicle to Use This Lane on the Highway
description: This is an HOV (High Occupancy Vehicle) highway sign, two or more passengers must be in the vehicle to use this lane on the highway.

name: Vehicles Cannot Change Lanes into or out of a HOV Lane in This Area
description: Vehicles cannot change lanes into or out of a high occupancy vehicle lane in this area.
